propositions: Canonical contributor guidance in AGENTS.md and .agents/rules/rebar.md hardcodes a specific bot identity (Joe Oakhart) instead of requiring contributors to use their own configured git identity.
CONTRIBUTING.md requires real contributor identity for DCO sign-off, but AGENTS.md and related guidance prescribe a specific third-party identity, creating a contract contradiction.
Documentation guidance must be updated to require committers to sign off with their own configured git identity (git config user.name/email) rather than a hardcoded personal bot identity.

A deterministic lint-integrated consistency check must be added to prevent reintroduction of hardcoded personal sign-off strings in contributor-facing documentation while excluding automation-owned paths (infra/, .github/workflows/, tests/, docs/experiments/).

All contributor-facing guidance files (AGENTS.md, .agents/rules/*.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, and docs/ markdown) must describe one consistent DCO contract naming the committer's own configured identity as the sign-off source.
